headline: 9 deaths in 24 hours: Highest daily dengue toll this year
summary: Bangladesh faces a record single-day surge in dengue deaths and hospitalizations, prompting the government to launch a 3-month special prevention campaign.
details: Nine people died of dengue in a single day, marking the highest daily death toll recorded so far this year. Hospitalizations also reached a record high for the year during the same 24-hour period.
A significant portion of the fatalities occurred in the Khulna division, where three people died within 24 hours.
In response to the escalating crisis, the government has initiated a special three-month program to prevent and control the spread of the virus.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has urged students to maintain cleanliness in their homes and schools to help curb the outbreak.
The Prime Minister is scheduled to launch the a 3-month campaign on Saturday to further intensify dengue prevention efforts across the country.
caption:
9 deaths in a single day. Bangladesh hits its highest daily dengue toll of the year.

Nine people died of dengue in a single day, marking the highest daily death toll recorded so far this year. Hospitalizations also reached a record high for the year during the same 24-hour period.

A significant portion of the fatalities occurred in the Khulna division, where three people died within 24 hours.

In response to the escalating crisis, the government has initiated a special three-month program to prevent and control the spread of the virus.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has urged students to maintain cleanliness in their homes and schools to help curb the outbreak.

The Prime Minister is scheduled to launch the a 3-month campaign on Saturday to further intensify dengue prevention efforts across the country.

headline: Historic milestone: Bangladesh's Dr. Khalilur Rahman becomes UNGA President
summary: Foreign Minister Dr. Khalilur Rahman has officially taken the oath as the President of the 81st session of the UN General Assembly in New York.
details: Bangladesh Foreign Minister Dr. Khalilur Rahman has officially taken the oath as the President of the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA). The ceremony took place on Tuesday, September 8, at the UN headquarters in New York.

In his speech following the oath, Dr. Rahman outlined his vision for the 81st session, focusing on resolving global crises, achieving Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), and addressing climate change.
He also emphasized the need for the General Assembly to play an effective role in maintaining global peace and security.
Following the formal swearing-in, Dr. Rahman is scheduled to preside over the first plenary session of the 81st UNGA session, with representatives from 193 member states in attendance.
